answer: Because the wander count is verified against the falcon text itself, the garden audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 200 aliases as a result means producing 200 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
